Residencia Por Inversión En Calidad Pensionado Y Jubilado

note: The Dominican Republic, read on 2026-10-31 in the Ministry of Public Administration's Catálogo de Organismos del Estado Dominicano (map.gob.do, COEDOM), its sheet for the Dirección General de Migración of the Ministry of Interior and Police (the catalogue as generated today; it states no date of its own), which lists the DGM's services under General Migration Law 285-04. The routes written are those for which the DGM lists an application ('Solicitud'), with renewable where it also lists a renewal ('Renovación'): the temporary work residence (RT-3), the managerial temporary residence (RT-2), the permit for artists, sportspeople and exchange students (PADEI, written as talent), residence by investment as a rentier and as a pensioner or retiree, the dependant's temporary residence (RT-7), the foreign student's permit (E-1), permanent residence (RP-1) and definitive residence (RD-1, no renewal listed). Also listed and not written: the ordinary temporary residence (RT-9), the religious' (RT-4), residence by investment for managerial or technical staff, permanent residence as an investor, the seasonal worker's permit (TT-1) and the border inhabitant's permit. The sheet gives no fee, term, decision time, place of application or work right; the DGM's own service pages and the RT-3 information sheet answer behind Cloudflare and weren't read.
